pending-clause.answer: SUBTRACT CORRESPONDING is an arithmetic statement (§2002:14.6.6) with size error (§2002:14.6.4), both changed in 2023. The rule only makes CORR and CORRESPONDING equivalent; 2002 arithmetic and size-error processing apply identically to both spellings, so neither difference changes what the rule governs. The 2002 witness l1_subtract_corr_word_equivalence compares the spellings and holds in any arithmetic mode; scope and evidence unchanged.
